description: List the time logged on a Jira issue. Returns each worklog's ID, author, time spent in Jira's words and in seconds, start time and comment as plain text, with the number of worklogs and the total time in seconds.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

max_results.description: Maximum number of worklogs to return (default 100)

name: atlassian-mcp__jira_list_worklogs
